decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is unrelated to the firm's existing maritime and logistics knowledge, providing little absorptive capacity to interpret results or improve it, making it likely to be dropped.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds on the firm's existing crew management knowledge, giving moderate absorptive capacity and potential to learn, so it is likely to be kept.
The maritime education programme directly leverages existing maritime expertise and partnerships, and its early success with six institutions signals strong absorptive capacity, so it should be kept.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services draw on existing regulatory and ship management knowledge, and the successful deadline compliance shows effective learning, indicating high absorptive capacity.
The emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software, building directly on existing software capabilities and data, so absorptive capacity is high and it should be kept.
The emissions compliance cost simulation tool also leverages the existing PAL platform and emissions expertise, indicating strong absorptive capacity and low likelihood of being dropped.
